summary: Area chart with a bright line over a dithered fill; ranges morph into each other and hover adds a crosshair and the value.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Header label and start of the chart `aria-label`. Without `data` it also seeds the demo data. Observed.

attributes.name: days
attributes.description: Range in days, at least 1. The range buttons offer 7, 30 and 90. Observed: changing it switches the range.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Daily values, oldest first: numbers or `{ value, date }` records (`date` as an ISO string or epoch ms). Observed: changing it morphs to the new series. Without it the chart shows demo data.

properties.name: data
properties.description: The same series as the `data` attribute, without JSON. Setting it redraws the chart; `null` returns to the demo data. Reading it returns your series or `null`.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"` and an `aria-label` of the form `<label>, last <n> days, <first> to <last>`.
The range buttons are native buttons in a `role="group"` labelled `Range`, with `aria-pressed`.
Hovered values and dates are pointer-only.
motion: With reduced motion the line is drawn in full at once, range changes swap without morphing, the header value changes without rolling and the canvas redraws only on input.
notes: With `data`, the range buttons show the last 7, 30 or 90 entries; shorter data shows every entry. Dates label the axis and the tooltip; without dates the days count back from today.
Values are drawn from zero up; negative values sit on the baseline.
The header shows the latest value, or the hovered day, and the change from the first to the last day of the range.
`data`, `label` and `days` are observed. A `data` value set before the element is defined is picked up when it upgrades.

data.note: Pass your daily values as `data`. Without it the chart shows demo data seeded from `label`.
